QC Microbiologist II (Contract to Hire)

Our client, Acme Bio, is a clinical-stage company developing cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Our Quality Control team supports manufacturing at our Springfield facility and ensures that every lot released meets our specifications.

Responsibilities
- Perform environmental monitoring of classified cleanrooms, including viable air, surface and personnel sampling.
- Execute compendial microbiology methods such as bioburden, endotoxin (LAL), sterility and growth promotion testing.
- Identify microbial isolates using MALDI-TOF and Gram staining, and trend results against alert and action levels.
- Author and revise standard operating procedures, test methods and protocols.
- Lead deviation investigations, root cause analysis and CAPA for out-of-specification and out-of-trend results.
- Review data for accuracy and completeness in accordance with cGMP and data integrity principles.
- Support method qualification and validation activities, including rapid microbial methods.
- Maintain lab equipment such as incubators, biosafety cabinets and autoclaves, and coordinate calibration.
- Train junior analysts on aseptic technique and laboratory safety.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Biology or a related science, with 3+ years of experience in a cGMP quality control laboratory.
- Hands-on experience with environmental monitoring programs and compendial methods (USP 61, 62, 71, 85).
- Working knowledge of FDA and EU GMP Annex 1 expectations for aseptic processing.
- Experience with LIMS and electronic batch records is a plus.
- Strong written communication and the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced setting.
- Ability to gown into Grade A and B areas and to lift up to 25 pounds.

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000 to $115,000 per year. Acme Bio offers medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) match and equity.

Springfield Staffing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
